purpose: Close indirect authorization leaks across search, deep links, employee profiles, Documents, Reports, Management aggregates, Archive/Trash, selectors and scoped supplier/organization directories.
security_boundaries: employee deep links and profile subsections follow page permission plus Branch scope
finalized Documents and source lookups follow Branch/Project scope
Reports require both report permission and the underlying sensitive page permission
Management aggregate/audit surfaces fail closed for narrowed scopes and unrelated access administrators
global search only queries exact permitted entity endpoints and requires shared.search.use
supplier and department indirect metrics cannot reveal out-of-scope workforce or financial totals
